content:
Marta Diaz: FYI I opened a hotfix docs PR to add the statuspage link + an SDK workaround for the rate-limiter outage (incident rdw-2026-03-20). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3847 — need review & merge before the deploy window later today.
Ben Cho: On it. pinging @Priya for copy review. Do we need a backport to release/v1-docs?
Priya Reddy: I'll skim now. Quick question — ops asked for a statuspage link only, do we also want the postmortem linked?
Marta Diaz: For now include the statuspage (live updates). Add the postmortem link later once it's published. Also include a short "known issue" note and a temporary SDK snippet showing a client-side workaround.
docs-bot: preview build failed: Missing frontmatter field `sidebar_position`. Build logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/9876
Marta Diaz: I can fix the frontmatter in a minute and push.
Ben Cho: Hold merge until preview is green. Also check redirects after you change any doc path.
Marta Diaz: Fixed frontmatter, pushed. SDK snippet updated to show temporary workaround: 
```javascript
// temporary workaround for v1 SDK until backend fix for rate limiting
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
client.setRetry(0); // disable internal retry to surface 429s so app can fallback gracefully
```
Priya Reddy: LGTM for copy. Suggest we use the word "workaround" (not "fix") and add an ETA note that we'll revert after the backend patch.
Lucas (eng-sre): Please add the exact statuspage URL and incident id. Statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-2026-03-20-rate-limit
Marta Diaz: Added the statuspage link and incident id. Also added a short recommendation: "if you receive 429s, fall back to cached answer or degrade to an embeddings-only flow."
deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-3847 — checks queued (unit, lint, docs-e2e).
docs-bot: docs-e2e: failing on redirect check — 301 loop encountered for /guides/migration -> /guides/migration/ (see logs).
Ben Cho: Looks like the statuspage link got a trailing slash in the markdown which triggered the redirect check. Pushing a tiny fix.
Ben Cho: Pushed redirect fix.
deploy-bot: docs-e2e: passed. Netlify preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-3847 ✅
Marta Diaz: Can someone merge? I'm moving into a meeting in 3 mins.
Priya Reddy: I'll do the merge after a final render check on the snippet.
Priya Reddy: Snippet renders fine, copy looks good. Merging now and creating a backport to release/v1-docs as a hotfix.
Marta Diaz: :thumbsup: Thanks! After merge please post the docs link in #incidents so PMs and CS have it.
Lucas (eng-sre): Will post to #incidents with statuspage + docs link once the merge is live.
Marta Diaz: Added a follow-up note in the PR to remove the workaround after the backend patch is deployed and to link the postmortem when available.
Ben Cho: Nice. Closing the loop here.
